proposed_capability: P95 architecture and P124 owner factoring: extend existing global-input-age screen arbitration with optional ephemeral foreground PID/executable name, configurable idle presets and human-first cooperative waits; evaluate skill-triggered likes/dislikes via game-qualified explicit catalog without conflating aspiration life-state, reward traits, or chance cards; guarded two-step Yes/Okay host actions on re-observed visible button targets, never blind coordinates.
player_save_control_impact: Host must pause while any user inputs occur anywhere on desktop (including dictation). Do not capture typed text, window titles, executable paths or external activity. PID/process basenames ephemeral only. No autonomous clicks without session/PID, independently observed current Sims dialog, fresh capture, visible exact target, cooperative screen lease, and per-step revalidation. Positive like/dislike choice is opt-in, unknown defaults HOLD.
expected_outcome: Extend one canonical presence probe/arbiter without parallel watcher; add versioned like/dislike policy and host-facing scoped action adapter; route optional observation through existing host turn; tests pin human precedence, no action on stale unknown negative prompts, two-step Yes then Okay and mid-action interruption.
negative_tests: Human input outside Sims blocks game and browser control
foreground PID/name is never activity-history logging nor permission
malformed process name fails closed for diagnostics without denying trusted idle
unknown or ambiguous preference stays HOLD and cannot click
dislike of useful skills rejects YES
positive like requires enabled opt-in and fresh Sim/modal
cannot send OK before YES was observed and resulting OK dialog independently reobserved
player-directed queue or inactive host session cannot click
interrupt between Yes and Okay stops and requires resampling
no life-state or reward-trait auto-accept bypass
CI offline PASS is not live Sims proof
rollback_path: Revert feature PR; pre-existing player-presence and aspiration policy continues; no settings/saves changed or watcher installed.
unresolved_unknowns: Sims pack/version prompt string variants and Yes/OK button geometry require local screenshot calibration
Live Win32 behavior, OS focus, and dictation IME signals need workstation P08 proof
